events.title: Hormuz CLOSED Day 164 - Iran vows closure until sanctions lifted
events.details: 8 ships vs 73/day normal. Tankers running dark through drone gauntlet. Trump claims normal but NYT contradicts. Iran demands all conditions met. Pakistan diplomatic signal. Trump demands reparations.

events.title: Ebola on track to surpass deadliest in history - 4,449 cases, 2,061 deaths
events.details: Bundibugyo species, no approved treatments. 53 health zones affected. WHO says trajectory will eclipse 11,000-death record. MSF running PARTNERS clinical trial.

events.title: US-Japan joint yen intervention unraveling - + already failing
events.details: Joint intervention Aug 5 ( Japan + -10bn US). Yen sank again by Aug 10. BOJ pressured to raise rates. BofA expects 6% yen strengthening by year-end.

events.title: Fed hike probability rising to 30% - Warsh signaling inflation concerns
events.details: Rates at 3.5-3.75%, 5th consecutive hold. Warsh emphasizing inflation without nuance. Markets pricing 30% hike probability.  Treasury refunding this week.

events.title: Gold hits ,399 - safe haven demand extreme amid multi-crisis
events.details: Gold ,399.22 (+0.66%). RED threshold breach above ,500 (+25.7%). Above ,000 AMBER (+46.6%). Hormuz + Ebola + yen crisis driving demand.

events.title: China  property time bomb as leases end - deflation war faltering
events.details: property threat as land leases expire. Deflation fight faltering. PBOC balancing yuan stability vs devaluation. New home-buying policies launched. Beijing lowering purchase thresholds.

events.title: Argentina country risk at 451bps - Brazil ambassador withdrawn
events.details: Argentina country risk climbed to 451bps. Brazil withdrew ambassador. Central bank reform vote Aug 19. Milei pushing BCRA charter change.

events.title: ECB holds at 2.25% - financial conditions tightening slightly
events.details: ECB cut 8 times Jun 2024-Jun 2025, then held. Now 2.25%. Financial conditions slightly tighter. No emergency.

events.title: BoE holds 6-3 - no emergency, gilt yields stable
events.details: BoE voted 6-3 to hold. Bailey downplayed tightening. Gilts stable. No crisis signals.

events.title: EM Asia currency defense - India rupee recovering, won leading declines
events.details: India lured  diaspora deposits, rupee recovering from May record low. Korea won biggest monthly gain since 2022 but now leading declines. No acute crisis.

events.title: South Africa silent crisis warned by central bank - Nigeria hostage rescues
events.details: SARB warns of silent crisis. Nigeria largest single-day hostage rescue. Anti-gang officers murdered. No new coups this period.

events.title: Regulatory oversight gaps widening - Russia bankruptcies +13.7%
events.details: Federal regulatory bodies face sweeping workforce reductions. Private market discipline must substitute for federal supervision. Russia bankruptcies rising 13.7% YoY. No acute US bank failure.
